info.title: joule
info.description:
Public API for the Chetto conversational intelligence platform.

## Rate Limits

All endpoints are rate-limited to **60 requests per minute** per API key and endpoint.
Requests exceeding this limit will receive a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

ProgressionMode.title: ProgressionMode
ProgressionMode.description:
How the schedule treats progression through stages.

INFERRED: when a substage in stage N fires, every substage in stages
1..N-1 is auto-fired as ``EventSource.INFERRED``. Useful when the LLM
detection is noisy and we trust that reaching a later stage implies the
earlier stages happened.

STRICT: no backfill. Only substages that were actually detected get
fired. Required when the client cares about strict adherence (did each
expected event actually occur?).

offset_id.description: Cursor ID for the next page; null when no more data

TimelineResponse.title: TimelineResponse
TimelineResponse.description:
Response for timeline endpoint with cursor-based pagination.

``offset_id`` is derived from the raw fetched documents, not the filtered output,
so a page that filters down to zero displayable items still returns a non-null
``offset_id`` (keep paging until it is null). ``data`` is ordered oldest-first
when more pages remain.

TimingAnchor.title: TimingAnchor
TimingAnchor.description: What a TimingRule's offset is measured from.

TimingRule.title: TimingRule
TimingRule.description:
When a substage is expected to fire.

Examples:
    Day 1, 7 PM IST:  anchor=subject_start, offset_days=0, offset_hours=19
    2 hours after the previous substage:  anchor=previous_substage, offset_hours=2
    Fixed datetime:  anchor=absolute, absolute_at=2026-05-12T19:00:00+05:30
